title: NRG Energy, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: NRG Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 disclosing concurrent offerings of senior secured notes due 2031 ($500M at 4.955%) and senior unsecured notes ($1.05B 5.875% due 2034; $1.05B 6.125% due 2036). A subsidiary, Lightning Power, LLC, also commenced a tender offer for any and all of its $1.5B outstanding 7.250% senior secured notes due 2032, along with a consent solicitation to eliminate restrictive covenants and release collateral.
key_points: NRG priced $500M of 4.955% senior secured first lien notes due 2031
NRG priced $1.05B of 5.875% senior unsecured notes due 2034
NRG priced $1.05B of 6.125% senior unsecured notes due 2036
Subsidiary Lightning Power commenced tender offer for $1.5B of 7.250% senior secured notes due 2032
Consent solicitation seeks to eliminate restrictive covenants and release guarantees/collateral on Lightning 2032 Notes
Total new debt issuance: $2.6B aggregate principal
why_it_matters: Corporate capital structure activity by NRG Energy involving $2.6B in new debt issuance and a $1.5B tender offer with consent solicitation. This is a liability management exercise to optimize the company's debt structure - releasing collateral and eliminating restrictive covenants on the Lightning 2032 Notes.
